subject: 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul
fact: The event occurs on the 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul.
source_quote: [Continuing — Date: 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul, Speaker: Grygum]

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thinks, 'That’s an illusion!'
source_quote: Grygum thinks, “That’s an illusion!”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters, 'No, it’s not.'
source_quote: but a piece of debris hit his toe, and he mutters, “No, it’s not.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouts, 'Stone giants never talk. And they certainly don’t bellow. Something is wrong.'
source_quote: Thorin, who overhears the giant, shouts, “Stone giants never talk. And they certainly don’t bellow. Something is wrong.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asks, 'And the two heads?'
source_quote: Grygum looks at him, “And the two heads?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'Two heads is more normal than bellowing.'
source_quote: “Two heads is more normal than bellowing.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum wonders if he should just run.
source_quote: For a moment, the priest of Bahamut wonders if he should just run.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asks, 'What is in it for me?'
source_quote: “What is in it for me?” he asks.

subject: teachings of Bahamut
fact: Grygum remembers the teachings of Bahamut that when you do a good turn for someone, they may do a good turn for you.
source_quote: And then he remembers the teachings of Bahamut that when you do a good turn for someone, they may do a good turn for you.

subject: Duergar patrol
fact: A Duergar patrol is seen racing towards the giant.
source_quote: A sign for Bahamut appears: a Duergar patrol racing towards this giant.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'If I fight him, we may get some friends.'
source_quote: “If I fight him, we may get some friends.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum raises his holy symbol and prepares to attack.
source_quote: He turns to his companion, raises his holy symbol, and prepares to attack.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir races into combat.
source_quote: With that, Zalthir and Thorin race into combat.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin races into combat.
source_quote: With that, Zalthir and Thorin race into combat.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz strikes first with magic missiles that streak from his hand.
source_quote: Daz strikes first with magic missiles that streak from his hand.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir places his circle of darkness just before the giant.
source_quote: Zalthir places his circle of darkness just before the giant and enters it.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir steps up to the giant and strikes with a flurry of blows.
source_quote: Stepping up to the giant, he strikes with a flurry of blows.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir misses the giant with his flurry of blows.
source_quote: But he misses.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir uses his power to focus his mind and strikes again.
source_quote: So Zalthir uses his power to focus his mind and strikes again.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir lands a glancing blow on the giant.
source_quote: This time it is a glancing blow.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin approaches the mad giant with blindsight and strikes him with his sword.
source_quote: Thorin rushes after Zalthir; with blindsight, he approaches the mad giant and strikes him with his sword.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum speaks the words of power that Bahamut has taught him.
source_quote: Grygum speaks the words of power that Bahamut has taught him, pointing his holy symbol at the mad giant

subject: mad giant
fact: The mad giant burns with necrotic damage and the power of Bahamut.
source_quote: Grygum speaks the words of power that Bahamut has taught him, pointing his holy symbol at the mad giant who burns with necrotic damage and the power of Bahamut.

subject: mad giant
fact: The mad giant roars and smashes Thorin.
source_quote: The giant roars and smashes Thorin,

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir deflects the giant's attack on Thorin just in time.
source_quote: but Zalthir, using his awareness of the monk, deflects the attack just in time.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is pleased.
source_quote: Daz is pleased,

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir places the darkness so that he can still strike the giant.
source_quote: and Zalthir places the darkness so that he can still strike him.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir speaks incantations and bolts of power fly from his finger, striking the giant.
source_quote: His fingers move in the air, the incantations are spoken, and bolts of power fly from his finger, striking the giant.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir strikes the giant once.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes the giant once,

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir focuses his mind on striking again and strikes the air.
source_quote: focusing his mind on striking again and striking the air.

subject: mad giant
fact: The mad giant is blind.
source_quote: The giant, although blind, dodges him.

subject: mad giant
fact: The mad giant is mad.
source_quote: Thorin rushes after Zalthir; with blindsight, he approaches the mad giant

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin feints and strikes the giant.
source_quote: Thorin feints and strikes the giant.

subject: mad giant
fact: The mad giant howls.
source_quote: The creature howls.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum raises his holy symbol again and speaks the words of power.
source_quote: Gyrgum raises his holy symbol again and speaks the words of power,

subject: mad giant
fact: The mad giant burns again.
source_quote: and the giant again burns.
